newsitem.title: CHINA: China April RPI up 1.1 pct yr/yr - State Statistic.
newsitem.headline: China April RPI up 1.1 pct yr/yr - State Statistic.

text.p: China's retail price inflation rose by 1.1 percent year-on-year in April, and rise 2.3 percent for the first four months compared with the year-ago period, the State Statistical Bureau said on Monday.
That compared with 1.7 percent for March.
The bureau said the costs of housing and some service had risen rather sharply in some areas and urged local governments to halt the increases.

The lowest rate of inflation was in southern Guangdong province, which recorded year-on-year negative growth in inflation of 1.3 percent in April, it said. Inflation in Shanghai was a negative 1.1 percent.
A total of 11 provinces and municipalities out of China's 31 reported inflation below the national average, it.
The highest rates of retail price inflation were 4.4 percent in the capital, Beijing, and in southwestern Sichuan province, it said..
China has set a target of 6.0 percent inflation for 1997 compared with 6.1 percent last year but officials expect the rate for the year to be as low as 3.0-4.0 percent.
